Hi Lydia —

Great to speak earlier — thanks for the time and for walking through Asteria's ingestion and billing flows. Per our call, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that focuses on the vendor enrollment milestones we discussed so we can get you live on Redwood Dedicated when the PO lands. High-level recap and proposed owners: 

- Milestone: Confirm vendor entity & legal name
  - Owner: Asteria (Lydia / Tom)
  - Target: 2026-05-21

- Milestone: W-9 & vendor banking details submitted
  - Owner: Asteria (Finance)
  - Target: 2026-05-24

- Milestone: Ariba supplier creation (or Coupa intake)
  - Owner: Redwood procurement (Ben Carter) — we will initiate supplier creation and share the portal invite
  - Target: 2026-05-28

- Milestone: Legal & SLA review sign-off
  - Owner: Redwood Legal / Asteria Legal (parallel)
  - Target: 2026-06-03

- Milestone: Banking validation & test invoice
  - Owner: Asteria finance + Redwood billing ops
  - Target: 2026-06-07

Dependencies: DocuSign supplier agreement executed, Ariba vendor code assigned, bank micro-deposit validation. Target close for onboarding: 2026-06-10 (to align with expected PO week of 6/14).

What I need from you this week to keep momentum: 
1) Confirm the primary procurement contact at Asteria (name + email) for Ariba invites.
2) Upload your W-9 to the secure link or attach to reply (I listed a placeholder on the MAP).
3) Indicate whether Asteria prefers Ariba (SAP) or Coupa for supplier intake — we can support both, but process differs slightly.

Attached: MAP_Draft_Asteria_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — it has the milestone table and editable owner cells.

If you'd like, Ben can kick off the Ariba intake once you confirm procurement contact; otherwise we'll provide the Coupa supplier enrollment checklist.

Thanks — I'll follow up mid-week with an updated MAP based on your answers.

—Sean
